name: house-lights
description: Seven skills for showing an idea to people: teach it by drawing (chalk-talk), present it (back-of-napkin), rehearse an incident (dress-rehearsal), map a team's way of working (gates-and-handoffs) and a customer journey (service-blueprint), compare Copilot Studio agents (cast-list), and simulate a process to ask «what if» (box-office) — with a mod that checks .sim recipes as Claude writes them.
